sentences.text: The fossil record of Machairasaurus includes some fragmentary foot elements.
The holotype specimen, IVPP V15979, was discovered in the late Campanian layers of the Bayan Mandahu Formation.
Five oviraptorid specimens associated with a nest, including a female found brooding near eggs, may belong to Machairasaurus.
In 2010, Machairasaurus was assigned to the family Oviraptoridae, specifically to the subfamily Ingeniinae.
Machairasaurus formed a smaller clade with Heyuannia, Conchoraptor, and Nemegtomaia.
Machairasaurus was found in the Upper Cretaceous Bayan Mandahu Formation in China.
Machairasaurus lived during the late Cretaceous, approximately 80 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
